name: Biribiri Panic Leotard Fairy
original_name: ビリビリパニック レオタードフェアリー
source:
Asaka and Miya are in the 3rd year of the rhythmic gymnastics club.
Thanks to the erotic training of their hot coach, the two girls have flourished.
Now in the final year of high school, they start thinking about their future and renew the fight over their coach!
